name: The person's own notes reach the brief, little else, nothing outside the scope
purpose: The notes a request needs from the person's saved notes about their focus are in the brief, with few others, and no note outside the person's scope is shown; a request about something else gets next to nothing. What the judge is shown is scored too: a request is justified a number of pages of candidates (one for a request nothing bears on, two for one standing note, three for the focus, four for ten relevant notes), reviewing more costs score and a standing note the review stops short of is missed recall.
record: Fifty-two invented neutral cases (evaluation/focus_context/build_cases.py, source tag invented-neutral): a fictional vegetable garden focus with its notes, kitchen notes sharing its words, a neighbour's notes in another scope and unrelated notes; thirteen kinds over four crops (the last held out): named_word, own_practice, fenced, unrelated, cross_focus, five trivial requests (time, date, arithmetic, definition, general knowledge) with nothing relevant, two trivial requests (time, date) that a standing note of the person bears on and that sits below stray-word distractors, and many_relevant (ten notes, more than a judge page). Per case: utility = 0.50 recall + 0.20 tidiness + 0.15 safety + 0.15 thrift, weights fixed before the judged arm ran (the free arms were first scored with 0.60/0.25/0.15 and no thrift); thrift is 1 within the case's max_pages of judge.PAGE_SIZE candidates, else max_pages over pages reviewed; a case passes at recall 1, safety 1, tidiness 0.5 or more and pages within max_pages. After the first real fast-tier run the needed sets were found biased toward what the word rule returns (the overview needed, the crop's newest care note counted as noise): the overview and general care notes became allowed, applied to every arm; the judge's second view was also found to exclude standing guidance by its wording and was reworded once. Free arms and a scripted oracle judge (plumbing, model simulated) ran first, then one real run on the fast tier (haiku-5-5 by the tier mechanism, 168 calls, $0.045 at the CLI's reported list price).
disadvantages: Invented cases written by the arm's author: real notes are less tidy; it scores which notes reach the brief, not whether a model's answer uses them; one case (a build request whose word check matches a rose note) fails and is kept as the finding. The real run is one sample of a stochastic judge; the case sets were widened and the prompt reworded after the first real run (both recorded); the judged arm misses a crop's second note in five fenced and named_word cases because the two views must agree.
cascading_conditionals: free [sample=full | real=no | gate=competitive | when=the arms that call no model were recorded on the same cases] > real [sample=sample:1 | real=yes | gate=competitive | when=a person authorized one fast-tier run of the terminal]
command: esoi run focus_context --impl no_context; esoi run focus_context --impl filesystem_search; esoi run focus_context --impl configured_focus_context; esoi run focus_context --impl llm_judged_focus_context --max-calls 700 (FOCUS_CONTEXT_JUDGE=scripted for the model-free plumbing stage)
